title: The Truth Series Crown Packet
claim: The Truth Series argues that truth is ontological: stable truth-bearing correspondence is not one feature inside reality but a precondition for intelligible science, accountable morality, fruitful work, law-stability, and organized agency. The series dissolves the is-ought gap by treating moral ought as time-indexed misalignment before consequence, shows that removing mathematics undermines accountability, shows that removing law-stability undermines fruitfulness, and argues that evil parasitizes truth rather than forming an independent foundation.
assumptions: Truth-bearing correspondence is required for comparison, measurement, accountability, and repair.
Stable mathematical and physical law structures are preconditions for science, work, stewardship, and fruitfulness.
Evil systems require local truth, order, identity, communication, and reliable relation to operate.
Moral agency arises when an agent can knowingly preserve or violate truth-bearing relation.
definitions: Structural morality: a system requires truth to remain coherent.
Agent morality: a person knowingly preserves or violates truth-bearing relation.
Truth as tool: truth used instrumentally, subordinated to an end it may not judge.
Truth as standard: truth is terminal; the whole operation answers to it, including the top.
Truth Series definition: morality begins wherever truth becomes necessary for right relation.
equations: ought(a, phi, t) := misaligned(state(a,t), phi) and consequences not yet arrived
remove stable mathematics -> remove reliable comparison -> undermine accountability
remove stable laws -> remove reliable cause/effect -> remove work -> remove fruitfulness
bridges: evil as parasitic on truth -> borrowed-goodness bridge
truth as Logos -> theological conditional bridge
negative_guards: Do not cite the whole series as Lean proof.
Do not cite the simulation as a measurement of the actual universe.
Do not claim math proves morality without the structural/agent morality distinction.
Do not promote the Logos conclusion beyond theological conditional until the Christian Logos bundle is tested.
Do not let persuasive public language outrun the ledger labels.
kill_conditions: A stable possible world is shown where truth-bearing correspondence fails but science, accountability, repair, and fruitfulness remain intelligible.
A moral ought is found with no present structural basis or truth relation.
A regime of total falsehood can communicate, coordinate, and persist without borrowing truth.
The simulation assumptions are shown to be irrelevant to the structural argument they are meant to demonstrate.
A rival model explains truth, science, accountability, law-stability, evil parasitism, and fruitfulness with fewer unresolved commitments.
